scope: FOCUSED final-confirmation regressions only; selected maintained helper bodies unchanged. Local SSR fixture and installed Privy SDK; public provider metadata fetched live and intercepted for fixtures. Most fixtures disable CAPTCHA; two email-send cases enable a synthetic Turnstile API to exercise the installed SDK callback and unmodified timeout paths. OTP/passkey provider endpoints and application responses, including durable wallet status/retry projections, are synthetic. Wallet fixtures assert no browser provider creation, signing, funding or transfer call. Real Chromium virtual-authenticator ceremonies exercise native passkey creation/assertion; real PostgreSQL acceptance is recorded separately. No real CAPTCHA validation, email delivery, genuine provider login/link/wallet creation, hosted session, physical device or complete WCAG conformance evidence.
